about: What openconnect 9.21 hands its hook (prepare_script_env, script.c 294-432; values from cstp.c 396-645), and what the hook makes of it: the event, the changes it applies for connect (OpenConnectPlan.Change text, the record's form) and its report line, or the refusal (OpenConnectNetwork.Failure, OpenConnectPlan.Failure). Each case's env is `base` with the case's variables on top (null removes one; `base_none: true` starts empty); `env_hex` sets raw bytes. Defaults: platform macos, policy uid 501, profile acme, set_routes and set_dns on, underlay ipv4 `198.51.100.1 en0`, no ipv6 and no attached (local) networks; `attached` lists `<network> <interface>`. Read by Tests/PassTunnelCoreTests/OpenConnectNetworkTests.swift.
